youtube_description: Edick Road Extension Trail goes from the end of Edick Road Extension to Piseco-Powley Road. The trail is relatively flat, as it goes through a quiet section of woods. The creeks are fairly well bridged by snowmobile bridges, as this is a key snowmobile connector route in the winter.
